posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Collagen supplements actually work when combined with Vitamin C.
Studies show measurable skin thickness improvement after 8 weeks.
posts.cta: Collagen supplements need Vitamin C to work.

posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Olive oil's oleocanthal has the same anti-inflammatory mechanism as ibuprofen.
3–4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil per day is therapeutic.
